name: research-skills-codex-package
genericization_policy: No specific user's research topic is preconfigured.
Project details are represented as variables in PROJECT_VARIABLES.md and DEVICE_CONFIG.md.
Topic-specific memory, examples, COMSOL outputs, local paths, and measured claims are removed.
Skill examples must remain generic templates or placeholders.
notes: Users must configure their own project variables before topic-specific analysis.
Bundled vendor dependencies are preserved for offline portability.
Skills are installed into the target Codex project by default, not global skill directories.
COMSOL workflows require a valid local COMSOL installation and license when used.
Origin Pro MCP workflows require Windows, Origin Pro 2020+ installed and running, and Windows Python 3.10+ with dependencies configured by setup-origin-pro-mcp.ps1.

Zotero workflows include a local/hybrid Zotero MCP server, Zotero Auto PDF Fetch plugin source, and sanitized config templates; users must provide their own Zotero API key file and library ID for write tools.
